responsibility: This header publishes the mc front end's token-kind enumeration. It defines the complete mcReserved_toktype set shared by the lexer, token buffer, diagnostics, and all parser passes, providing the stable symbolic vocabulary for Modula-2 source tokens.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the published token-kind definition shared across the module, exposing mcReserved_toktype to importers, whereas GmcReserved.cc exists mainly as the companion implementation unit with init/fini stubs.
